newsitem.title: JAPAN: INSIGHT - JGBs to consolidate, topside near 123.50.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - JGBs to consolidate, topside near 123.50.

text.p: Japanese government bond (JGB) futures are expected to be firm on Tuesday in the wake of good overnight gains on the back of the yen's surge against the dollar, with moves in the foreign exchange market expected to be one key factor in trade today.
The market will also closely watch moves in the Nikkei after New York stocks posted another record close, although strong gains are seen as unlikely.
But with the downside in JGBs growing firmer after Monday's rises, trade is expected to be range-bound, with the topside limited to around 123.50 on technical factors.
"JGBs are definitely trending upwards, with a try of 124 possible in the near future. But a lack of fresh buying factors may limit gains today," one securities firm trader said.

Strength in the medium-term sector, which was largely responsible for Monday's strong gains in Tokyo, is likely to continue, as bonds of these maturities appear to be comparatively inexpensive, a trust bank trader said.

The market will be watching figures for April machinery orders, which are due out at 0500 GMT today. Poor numbers could raise concerns about the strength of the economy and possibly push bonds even higher.
